title: Porter governor
object: Porter flyball governor with bevel drive, bell crank and double-beat steam throttle valve, in axial section
idea: Negative-feedback proportional control: the speed sets the opening, so more load is carried at a lower speed (droop)
summary: Two iron balls on equal arms lift a weighted sleeve as the spindle speeds up, and the sleeve shuts a balanced double-beat valve through a bell crank. When the load steps up the engine slows, the balls drop, the valve opens, and the engine settles at a new, slightly lower speed. That offset is the droop of a proportional controller, plotted against the governor's own characteristic.
usedFor: Control engineering teaching: feedback, proportional control, droop and lag
Steam and mill-engine history and museum interpretation
A software-concept explainer for autoscaling and proportional controllers
